CLINICAL DOCUMENTATION — NARRATIVE AMBULATORY PROGRESS NOTE V1
Patient: Matthew Thompson | MRN: PAT-60020 | DOB: 1968-05-14 | Gender: Male | Doc ID: NARRATIVE_0020
Encounter Date: 2025-07-03 | Discharge/Note Date: 2025-07-06 | Provider: Dr. Allison Cameron, MD
SUBJECTIVE INTERVAL HISTORY
SUBJECTIVE INTERVAL HISTORY: Patient Matthew Thompson presents for longitudinal chronic disease management.
Since the last comprehensive visit three months ago, the patient reports adherence to diet and exercise recommendations.
Recent outpatient send-out interval laboratory check showed potassium of 4.46 mmol/L. Concurrent testing noted that
fasting alanine aminotransferase (alt) was 28 U/L. The patient denies any acute side effects or hypoglycemic episodes.
CLINICAL COURSE & PROGRESSION
CLINICAL COURSE & PROGRESSION: Over the preceding quarter, therapy with Azithromycin at 500 mg by mouth QD for
5 days was maintained. In-clinic point-of-care glucose was 88.2 mg/dL, confirming steady metabolic control. Vascular and
sensory examinations of bilateral feet were normal without neuropathy.
UPDATED CHRONIC MEDICATION PLAN
UPDATED CHRONIC MEDICATION PLAN: Refills were renewed for Atorvastatin 20 mg by mouth once daily at bedtime, as
well as Metformin 850 mg oral twice daily. Patient demonstrated proper technique and confirmed understanding of morning
versus evening administration.
FOLLOW-UP & COORDINATION
Return to clinic in six months for repeat comprehensive metabolic panel and lipid panel. Routine health maintenance
screenings were reviewed and scheduled.
